clue.text: Old eco-warrior gets politician into power

indicators.note: into says the politician goes inside the word for power

parts.note: sway is power or influence
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A veteran environmental protester manages to get an MP into a position of power.
explanation.walkthrough: Swampy was a well-known British road-protest activist of the 1990s, famous for tunnelling under building sites.
explanation.definitionFit: The nickname belongs to Daniel Hooper, a celebrated British environmental campaigner of the 1990s, now an older figure.

clue.text: Wine barrel shortened by instrument

parts.note: sack is an old name for a dry white wine such as sherry

indicators.note: shortened says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a butt is a large cask or barrel

explanation.surface: A wine cask is cut down to size by a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The sackbut is an early form of trombone, a brass instrument of the Renaissance.

clue.text: Film awards back to front at the back

indicators.note: back to front says the last letter comes round to the front

parts.note: the BAFTAs are the British Academy film awards

explanation.surface: The film awards ceremony is run back to front at the rear.
explanation.definitionFit: Abaft is a nautical word meaning towards or at the stern, the back of a ship.

clue.text: Bloom's bird nonsense

parts.note: a poppy is a bloom, a flower; the 's is a link
a cock is a male bird

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a flower's bird as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Poppycock is an informal word for nonsense or foolish talk.

clue.text: Flair for 12 suffering

parts.note: the answer to 12 is universal, and pan- is the Greek prefix meaning all or universal
an ache is suffering or pain

explanation.surface: Someone shows a flair for something that affects everyone in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; 12 refers to the answer UNIVERSAL, which the prefix PAN- means.
explanation.definitionFit: Panache is stylish flamboyance, a dashing flair in how something is done.

clue.text: Looking around Oriental capital (old style)

indicators.note: around says the capital surrounds the letter for Oriental

parts.note: Peking is the old romanised name of Beijing, the Chinese capital
E for eastern, the abbreviation used for Oriental

explanation.surface: Someone peers around an old Asian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Peeking means looking quickly or furtively, so it can replace looking.

clue.text: Ideal position for local French hospital?

indicators.note: local is read as situated there, with the hospital put inside the French place

parts.note: a French place: the Riviera city of Nice
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A question about the perfect spot for a neighbourhood hospital in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the loose reading: a local hospital in Nice puts H within NICE. 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a position perfectly suited to someone, an ideal slot or role.

clue.text: Hacks take credit for dining utensil

parts.note: chops means hacks or cuts
tick is informal British for credit, as in buying on tick

explanation.surface: Journalists put a meal implement on account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take' is a link word. 'Hacks' looks like journalists but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A chopstick is one of a pair of sticks used for eating, a utensil for dining.

clue.text: Ancient solvers holding girl up without much ado

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, says the whole is read from bottom to top
holding says the old pronoun contains the girl's name

parts.note: ye is the archaic you, addressing the solvers
Lisa is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Old puzzlers lift a girl effortlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: YE holding LISA gives YLISAE, which 'up' turns over.
explanation.definitionFit: Easily means without difficulty, that is with no great fuss or ado.

clue.text: Rodent, one supporting a painful condition

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting puts the letter for one below the rest

parts.note: gout is a painful inflammation of the joints
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A small animal props up someone suffering a painful ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: The agouti is a burrowing rodent of Central and South America.

clue.text: Mixed 4 milligrams of drink

indicators.note: mixed tells us to jumble the letters of the 4 answer together with the abbreviation

parts.note: the answer to 4 across is panache
mg is the standard abbreviation for milligrams

explanation.surface: A recipe mixes a few milligrams of something into a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The 4 across answer PANACHE plus MG are rearranged together.
explanation.definitionFit: Champagne is a sparkling wine, so it is an example of a drink.

clue.text: Get over feeling irritated

definitions.meaning: to get over or traverse something, such as a road
... as an adjective means annoyed or bad-tempered

explanation.surface: Someone is told to move on from a grudge while still annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a verb meaning traverse and as an adjective meaning angry or annoyed.

clue.text: However, 20 went out for a snack

parts.note: but and however both introduce a contrast

indicators.note: out says the letters of went are removed

parts.note: 20 is written out in words as twenty, not a reference to another answer

explanation.surface: Despite this, twenty people left to grab a bite to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 looks like a cross-reference to 20 down, but here it is just the number spelt out, from which WENT goes out to leave TY. A butty is northern British slang for a sandwich.
explanation.definitionFit: A butty is a sandwich in northern English slang, a typical quick snack.

clue.text: Picture makers getting valuers in

indicators.note: getting is read as becoming or working into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Film producers call in assessors to value their assets.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of VALUERS and IN rearrange into the name of the Hollywood studio.
explanation.definitionFit: Universal Pictures is a major Hollywood film studio, a maker of motion pictures.

clue.text: Excursion to oil-producing city

parts.note: a trip is an excursion or outing

indicators.note: producing is read as bringing out the letters in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A tour heads to a town that drills for petroleum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link word. Libya's capital really is in an oil-producing country, which helps the disguise; 'producing' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is the capital of Libya, and also a city in Lebanon.

clue.text: Single woman accepting a drink that's fantastic

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: accepting says the woman's name takes the other letters inside

parts.note: Mary is a woman's name
gin is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: A lone woman takes a drink that she finds wonderful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Imaginary and fantastic both mean existing only in fantasy, unreal.

clue.text: Almost lose sight of mischief maker

indicators.note: almost means the phrase is not quite complete, losing its final letter

parts.note: to go blind is to lose one's sight

explanation.surface: Someone nearly loses track of a troublemaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A goblin is a mischievous sprite of folklore, a classic maker of mischief.

clue.text: "Let them have it!" — local Indian proverb?

indicators.note: local is read as situated there, with the proverb placed inside the Indian city

parts.note: an Indian place: the city of Bombay, now Mumbai
a saw is an old saying or proverb

explanation.surface: A question whether a battle cry is a traditional saying from India.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsy: a proverb that is local to the Indian city sits inside its name. The answer is the cry of a bomber crew releasing its load.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry released by bomber crews as they drop their load, an order to let the enemy have it.

clue.text: Satisfied about vessel's sales potential

indicators.note: about says the word for satisfied goes around the vessel

parts.note: met as in met a demand, satisfied it
Noah's ark is a vessel

explanation.surface: Content with how a boat's sales prospects look.
explanation.definitionFit: A market is the demand or scope for selling a product, its potential for sales.

clue.text: It's for pinning colour on half of air gun

parts.note: a tint is a colour or shade

indicators.note: half of says only one half of the word for the air gun is kept

parts.note: ack-ack is anti-aircraft gunfire, a gun firing into the air

explanation.surface: A tiny pin attaches a coloured patch to part of an anti-aircraft weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word. Ack-ack was wartime signallers' slang for anti-aircraft fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A tintack is a short tinned nail, a small thing used for pinning.

clue.text: Seek information on family of fruit

parts.note: to pump someone is to question them persistently for information
kin are one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: Someone questions their relatives about some fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A pumpkin is a large orange gourd, botanically a fruit.

clue.text: P-premature description of London's king

parts.note: the stammered letter at the start supplies a single P
early means premature, before the due time

explanation.surface: An early stammered account of a London monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: A Pearly King is a London costermonger leader in a suit covered in pearl buttons.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes the Pearly King, a traditional East London charity figure in a button-covered suit.

clue.text: Central rule can break down

indicators.note: break down says these letters fall apart and reform

explanation.surface: A key regulation is able to collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuclear means forming a nucleus or core, so central.

clue.text: Round lump sum of old money

parts.note: O is a round shape
a bolus is a soft rounded lump, as of chewed food

explanation.surface: A round sum of money from long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sum of' is a link phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The obolus was a small coin of ancient Greece, an old unit of money.

clue.text: In Iran, bat supplies the national emblem

indicators.note: supplies is read as yields or provides once the letters are made over into something new

explanation.surface: In Iran, a cricket bat apparently provides the country's symbol.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of IN IRAN BAT rearrange into the female figure that personifies Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Britannia, the helmeted woman with trident and shield, is the personification and emblem of Britain.

clue.text: Military encounter in the fashion of the moment

parts.note: à la is French for in the style or fashion of
mo is short for moment, as in wait a mo

explanation.surface: A battle fought in the style of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo was the 1836 siege and battle at a Texas mission, a famous military engagement.

clue.text: The lad in charge of the boom, perhaps

parts.note: a son is a lad, a male child

explanation.surface: The boy is responsible for the boom on a film set or yacht.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link word. The boom suggests a sound boom or a sail's boom; it is the sonic boom of an aircraft passing the sound barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: Sonic means relating to sound, and a sonic boom is one example of something so described.

clue.text: Musicians without access to websites?

parts.note: no as in having none, without
the net is the internet, which gives access to websites

explanation.surface: A group of musicians who cannot get online.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine musicians, a band of players.

clue.text: Creeper effecting a clawback

indicators.note: back says the pieces are read in reverse order

parts.note: a nail is a claw on an animal's toe

explanation.surface: A climbing plant is helping to recover something by its grip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clawback' looks like one word meaning a recovered payment, but splits into claw and back; A NAIL turned around gives the vine. 'effecting' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A liana is a woody climbing vine of tropical forests, a type of creeper.

clue.text: A weapon receiving humble consideration

indicators.note: receiving says the weapon takes the word for humble inside it

parts.note: a lance is a weapon, a long spear
low means humble or lowly in rank

explanation.surface: A knight's spear is given a modest reception.
explanation.definitionFit: An allowance is consideration given, as in making allowance for someone's difficulties.

clue.text: Shakespearean young lovers initially in trauma

indicators.note: in says the initial letters go inside the word for trauma

parts.note: shock is a trauma or upsetting experience

indicators.note: initially says take the first letter of each of the two words

explanation.surface: Young couples in a Shakespeare play suffer great distress.
explanation.walkthrough: Shylock is the moneylender in The Merchant of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: Shylock is a character created by Shakespeare, so he can be described as a Shakespearean figure.

clue.text: Onyx set near every other jewel's origin

indicators.note: every other means take alternate letters, starting with the first

explanation.surface: An onyx is mounted beside every second gemstone's source.
explanation.definitionFit: The oyster is the shellfish in which a pearl forms, so it is a jewel's origin.
